About Me League bowler, 2 perfect games, 792 highest series
After starting in a league this year after 6yrs away, I decided to look for a new (used) ball since my Brunswick Python was 14yrs old.
I looked around and found Motiv and loved their ball guide and used it and the retired balls to help me pick a good one.
Well, even though I was reluctant to use the Top Thrill Solid, it turns out to be the best ball for me.
I'm about 400rpms, 4 step approach from the 12.5' mark and around the 30th board. My line out to the right varies on my release and I do not use an arrow for alignment, I just bowl on feel.
5 weeks ago I settled on the Top Thrill after trying the others throughout the night - bad idea!. Since committing to the Top Thrill Solid, I've bowled - 602; 646; 696, 744; 691.
I wish I found the Top Thrill Solid sooner. Perfectly matched ball for me.
This would be an amazing ball for any beginner bowler with limited funds or just for a guy who wanted his own ball and doesn't bowl a lot. But, it won't be replacing anything in my current bag.
